summary: Backend-only verification of Resend email sender configuration. All outbound Resend calls now use noreply@solarisounds.com (verified by static grep + in-process mock of _resend.Emails.send). Registration fires BOTH admin alert and welcome email as async tasks. Support contact fires admin notify + user ack (uses body.email override, subject startswith 'We received your message · ['). Password reset uses correct from. All flows silently no-op when RESEND_API_KEY blank / _resend module absent. HTML escaping verified for user_name and message payloads. All 32 tests pass (8 new + 24 regression).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now >7000 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules (auth, billing, support, admin, email) for maintainability. Not a functional bug for this iteration.

_RESEND_SENDER default fallback in server.py:236 is still 'onboarding@resend.dev'. Harmless (env var overrides it) but leaving the string in source could confuse future readers. Consider setting the fallback to '' and letting _send_email_sync no-op when unset.
seed_data_creation: None — tests self-clean users prefixed test_reg_* and support_messages via existing fixture
context_for_next_testing_agent: In-process ASGI testing requires rebinding motor client to the current event loop (see app_client fixture) because module-level AsyncIOMotorClient binds to the loop of first use. pytest-asyncio spins a fresh loop per test → 'Event loop is closed'. Fixture handles this via monkeypatch on server.client / server.db. Also note: pydantic EmailStr lowercases emails so compare against email.lower() when checking recipient lists.
verified_behaviors: server._RESEND_SENDER resolves to noreply@solarisounds.com at import time
Exactly 3 _resend.Emails.send call sites (server.py lines 246, 1043, 1213), all use _RESEND_SENDER
POST /api/auth/register fires _queue_admin_signup_alert + _send_welcome_email as asyncio.create_task; both send with from=noreply@solarisounds.com
POST /api/support/contact fires admin notify + _send_support_ack_to_user; both from=noreply@solarisounds.com; ack subject startswith 'We received your message · ['
User ack uses body.email preferentially, falls back to account email when omitted
POST /api/auth/forgot-password sends reset email with from=noreply@solarisounds.com
All 4 flows silent no-op when RESEND_API_KEY/_resend cleared — register still returns 200
HTML escaping: <script> in user_name renders as <script> in welcome + support-ack templates
